title: Phone-width controls and a refused form's accessibility
assertion: At 390 px an input, a select and a text area are at least 16 px; at 1280 px they are 14 px; a refused form passes axe (WCAG 2.1 A and AA) at both widths; at 390 px a page of forms does not scroll sideways, refused or not, and a select that cuts its chosen text short shows that text whole under it, as no select at 1280 px needs to
noFileReason: The public request form, synthetic practices’ forms, the uploads drop zone and the console’s status page are measured and scanned in the browser; no file.
